verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any data export or offboarding feature, such as bulk export of the ledger, transactions, or documents in open formats like CSV. The Connect API's read endpoints (chart of accounts, ledger entries, statements) and the read-only MCP server are only building blocks a developer could use to assemble an export, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
